In [[Group theory#Finite group theory|finite group theory]], '''Dade's conjecture''' is a [[conjecture]] relating the numbers of [[character theory|characters]] of [[Modular representation theory#Blocks and the structure of the group algebra|blocks]] of a [[finite group]] to the numbers of characters of blocks of local [[subgroup]]s, introduced by [[Everett C. Dade]].
